member.summary: The default implementation. Holds bindings and producers, performs the reflection-based injection, and (depending on shouldThrowException) either throws on errors or records them for later inspection through .

member.name: M:Com.Bit34Games.Injector.InjectorContext.#ctor(System.Boolean)
member.summary: Create a new injector context.

param.name: shouldThrowException
param.para: When true (recommended for almost all use cases, including production), the injector throws an immediately when an error occurs.

When false, errors are recorded into an internal list — intended for development and tests only. In this mode returns a no-op setter on error and returns default(T); callers must check after the bind phase to see what went wrong. See README "Creating Injector" for the full contract.

member.name: T:InjectAttribute
member.summary: Marks a field or property as a target of dependency injection. Members tagged with [Inject] are set during using the registered binding for the member's type.

remarks.para: This attribute lives in the global namespace by design — usage stays terse ([Inject] rather than [Com.Bit34Games.Injector.Inject]) and no using directive is required at the call site.
Public, internal, and private members are all supported. Properties must have a (possibly private) setter; getter-only properties are silently skipped at cache build time.
